title: Downgrade Premium Basis and the Year's Annual Reward
content:
On Northgate Memberships the Plus premium returned when a Plus membership is moved to its base tier during a membership year already paid at the Plus fee is worked from the downgrade premium basis, which depends on when in the year the downgrade falls and on whether the membership has earned Annual Reward in the current year.

## Terms

- **Current-year Plus premium:** the new membership and renewal fees paid for the current membership year net of refunds of them, less the annual fee of the base tier now held.
- **Annual Reward earned in the current year:** the reward accrued for the current membership year less the reward reversed for it. The membership has earned Annual Reward in the current year when this is above zero.
- **Days after the first day:** calendar days from the first day of the current membership year to the downgrade date; a downgrade on the first day is 0 days after it.
- **Whole months remaining:** whole calendar months from the downgrade date to the expiry date; a month counts only when the expiry date's day of the month has reached the downgrade date's day of the month.

## Rule

When the downgrade falls no more than 60 days after the first day of the current membership year and the membership has earned Annual Reward in the current year, the downgrade premium basis is the current-year Plus premium less that Annual Reward, rounded to the cent. When the downgrade falls more than 60 days after the first day of the current membership year and the membership has earned Annual Reward in the current year, the downgrade premium basis is the current-year Plus premium multiplied by the whole months remaining from the downgrade date to the expiry date and divided by twelve, rounded to the cent. A membership that has earned no Annual Reward in the current year has the full current-year Plus premium as its downgrade premium basis.

| Days after the first day | Annual Reward earned in the current year | Downgrade premium basis |
|---|---|---|
| 60 or fewer | above zero | current-year Plus premium less that Annual Reward |
| more than 60 | above zero | current-year Plus premium multiplied by whole months remaining, divided by twelve |
| any | none | the full current-year Plus premium |

## Worked cases (hypothetical; year 1 January to 31 December 2027, current-year Plus premium 65.00)

| Downgrade date | Days after the first day | Annual Reward earned | Whole months remaining | Downgrade premium basis |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 20 February 2027 | 50 | 12.40 | — | 65.00 less 12.40: 52.60 |
| 2 March 2027 | 60 | 12.40 | — | 52.60 |
| 3 March 2027 | 61 | 12.40 | 9 | 65.00 multiplied by 9, divided by twelve: 48.75 |
| 15 May 2027 | 134 | 12.40 | 7 | 65.00 multiplied by 7, divided by twelve: 37.92 |
| 15 May 2027 | 134 | none | — | 65.00 |
